input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Content Creator roles. It manages core business objects including auth component, request info component, info request, user response. The platform provides capabilities for info, user, info. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage auth component records, so that I can track and organize auth component data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage request info component records, so that I can track and organize request info component data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage info request records, so that I can track and organize info request data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user response records, so that I can track and organize user response data effectively.
